}}'''Smithery''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Swordsman]], a powerful front-line melee [[unit]], and the [[Forge]], a [[building]] that provides two [[population]] for each adjacent [[Mine]]. 

The [[Vengir]] [[tribe]] starts with Smithery. Starting with Smithery does not allow researching [[Mining]], as technologies cannot be researched backwards.
